propositions: Container tickets with empty own file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing unnecessary re-review on every merge regardless of code change relevance.

Container plan-review should inherit the union of direct children's declared file_impact, applying a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the pre-change fallback behavior is preserved.
Child file_impact edits or additions/removals must invalidate the container attestation via material-fingerprint pin drift to prevent silently stale inherited scope.
The plan-review pipeline must thread assembled child context from the orchestrator through sign_plan_review and dependency_hashes without new store reads.
P9 validation should surface an advisory (non-blocking) on containers whose inheritance is poisoned, naming the children with undeclared file_impact.
